Thanks — May 20 at 13:00 ET works for our team. Well also hold the optional dry run on Tue May 19 at 20:00 ET (30m) to validate connectivity and bring-up.

Updated attachments: Ive pushed a revised MAP (FinTrust_MAP_v1.xlsx) with added security lead placeholder and a short checklist. Ive also added a one-page runbook to the Drive link for the load rehearsal.

For the load rehearsal: we propose the following script (short):
1) Connectivity + model variant sanity checks (5m)
2) Warm-up sweep at 50 t/s for 60s (to prime caches)
3) Baseline sweep at 200 t/s for 90s (monitor latency, error-rate)
4) Burst to 500 t/s for 30s (watch autoscale/fallback behavior)
5) Post-check: KV cache hit rate and example prompt quality sanity (10m)

Please confirm the sample prompt set you shared contains any long-context cases (12k) flagged so we can adjust kernel selection and node config.

See you on the 20th — Mina
